fact: Land-constrained site in Queens bounded by Flushing Bay and dense urban fabric; operates under a perimeter rule and FAA slot controls.
judgment_note: Effectively no room for additional runway capacity; terminal rebuild only. Most congested / least expandable combination in the US.

fact: Slot-controlled, perimeter rule, tight Potomac-side site with noise-sensitive approaches.
judgment_note: Very limited physical expansion potential.

fact: Operates under a 1985 settlement agreement with Newport Beach (amended 2003 and 2014) imposing an annual passenger cap and a cap on average daily departures, plus a night curfew; curfew extended through 2035.
judgment_note: Demand is legally capped rather than physically constrained. Capacity investment cannot be monetised without renegotiating the settlement.

fact: Runways 28L/28R are separated by roughly 750 ft, far below the spacing required for independent simultaneous instrument approaches, so arrival rates fall sharply in low-visibility conditions. Bay-fill expansion faces major environmental hurdles.
judgment_note: Terminal investment feasible; runway reconfiguration extremely difficult.

fact: Peninsular site in Boston Harbor bounded by water and East Boston; long-standing community noise agreements.
judgment_note: Terminal and gate modernisation feasible; airfield expansion largely not.

fact: Large site with an active multi-billion-dollar terminal redevelopment programme; airfield is slot-controlled.
judgment_note: Terminal capacity investable; airfield capacity fixed by slots.

fact: Constrained Newark Bay site; Level 2 schedule facilitation.
judgment_note: Terminal redevelopment feasible; airfield growth limited.

fact: Completed a major airfield modernisation reconfiguring parallel runways; substantial airfield land.
judgment_note: Among the more expandable large hubs.

fact: Hemmed in by dense development on all sides; runway realignment proposals have faced sustained community opposition.
judgment_note: Terminal / people-mover investment feasible; new runway capacity unlikely.

fact: Very large land holding with substantial undeveloped area inside the airport boundary.
judgment_note: High physical expandability.

fact: One of the largest airport land holdings in the world with room for additional runways and concourses.
judgment_note: Highest physical expandability among US large hubs.

fact: High-throughput parallel runway layout on a constrained footprint between highways and communities.
judgment_note: Efficient but limited room for further airfield growth.

fact: Large site with available land.
judgment_note: Good expandability.

fact: Narrow site between Puget Sound and residential areas; third runway was heavily contested.
judgment_note: Terminal expansion constrained; airfield expansion very difficult.

fact: Substantial land holding in Windsor Locks with room for terminal and apron expansion.
judgment_note: Strong physical expandability; regional overflow candidate for the Boston catchment.

fact: Room for terminal and apron expansion; recently extended primary runway.
judgment_note: Strong expandability; regional overflow candidate.

fact: Large site with significant unused capacity and room to grow.
judgment_note: Strong expandability; regional overflow candidate.

fact: Hilltop site with terrain and frequent low-visibility limitations.
judgment_note: Moderate expandability; weather-limited.

fact: Room for terminal expansion.

fact: Constrained by surrounding development but has terminal expansion room.
